# Requirements & Traceability Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the specification, and traceability-chain integrity
**Created**: 2026-09-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · **Constitution**: v1.1.0 · **Domains**: 1 (Requirements), 16 (Traceability)
**Mode**: **Requirements-quality** — items test whether requirements are *written* well, not whether code works

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. IDs run continuously across all six checklist files in this
directory (CHK001–CHK186) so every ID is unique across the set.

**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned. `[x]` means the reviewer determined the criterion is satisfied for
requirements quality. It does **not** mean implementation work is complete. This command generated every item
unchecked; the agent's evaluation of `[Now]` items is reported separately in conversation and does **not** tick
boxes.

**Phase tags**: `[Now]` evaluable against current artifacts · `[Post-Tasks]` needs `tasks.md` ·
`[Pre-Release]` needs implementation, tests, or evidence

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 — Are functional and non-functional requirements separately identifiable rather than merged into undifferentiated prose? [Now] [Completeness, Constitution I]
- [ ] CHK002 — Does every requirement carry a stable identifier that downstream artifacts can reference? [Now] [Traceability, Constitution I]
- [ ] CHK003 — Are requirements present for all twelve orchestration stages named in the assignment, with none silently omitted? [Now] [Coverage, Spec §FR-ORC-001]
- [ ] CHK004 — Are requirements present for all twenty functional areas the assignment enumerates (URL and orchestration)? [Now] [Coverage]
- [ ] CHK005 — Are requirements defined for all eleven non-functional areas the assignment enumerates? [Now] [Coverage, Spec §NFR]
- [ ] CHK006 — Is every requirement's source classified as Confirmed, Derived, or Assumption-dependent, with the entailment named for Derived items? [Now] [Traceability, Spec §Reading Guide]
- [ ] CHK007 — Are requirements stated for the *absence* of behavior where absence is the requirement (no destination-based deduplication, no HTTP key issuance, no personal data)? [Now] [Completeness, Spec §FR-URL-012/019, §NFR-SEC-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 — Is every requirement free of undefined qualitative adjectives ("robust", "fast", "intuitive", "appropriate") that no test could adjudicate? [Now] [Clarity]
- [ ] CHK009 — Is every numeric threshold either an approved validation target with a stated identifier, or explicitly labelled as unapproved? [Now] [Measurability, Spec §Validation Targets]
- [ ] CHK010 — Are the terms "rollback" and "compensation" defined distinctly enough that a reader can classify a given effect without guessing? [Now] [Clarity, Spec §FR-ORC-016]
- [ ] CHK011 — Is "material" defined or exemplified wherever it gates behavior (material ambiguity, material change, material risk)? [Now] [Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK012 — Are the terminal and non-terminal run states enumerated exhaustively, so no state is left implicitly classified? [Now] [Clarity, Spec §FR-ORC-017]
- [ ] CHK013 — Is the distinction between a human *deciding* a gate and a human *implementing* a stage stated explicitly rather than left to inference? [Now] [Clarity, Spec §KE-25]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 — Do any two requirements impose contradictory obligations on the same behavior? [Now] [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK015 — Is every approved validation target consistent with the requirement it constrains, with no target contradicting an acceptance criterion? [Now] [Consistency, Spec §Validation Targets]
- [ ] CHK016 — Are clarification-log decisions reflected in every requirement they touch, with no requirement still stating a superseded position? [Now] [Consistency, Spec §Clarification Log]
- [ ] CHK017 — Are change-control amendments reflected in every affected requirement, not only in the change record? [Now] [Consistency, Spec §Change-control amendments]
- [ ] CHK018 — Do the specification, plan, and contracts agree on every field name, enum value, and state name they share? [Now] [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 — Does every functional requirement carry at least one positive acceptance criterion? [Now] [Acceptance Criteria]
- [ ] CHK020 — Does every functional requirement carry at least one **negative** criterion stating what must not happen? [Now] [Acceptance Criteria, Failure Path]
- [ ] CHK021 — Is required evidence named for each requirement, so completion is not assertable without it? [Now] [Measurability, Constitution XI]
- [ ] CHK022 — Can every acceptance criterion be adjudicated by an observer with no access to the authoring session? [Now] [Measurability, Constitution X]
- [ ] CHK023 — Are success criteria technology-agnostic, free of framework, language, or vendor references? [Now] [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 — Are requirements defined for primary, alternate, exception, and recovery flows in each of the three demonstration scenarios? [Now] [Coverage, Spec §Demonstration Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK025 — Is every enumerated edge case referenced by at least one requirement, with no orphan edge case? [Now] [Coverage]
- [ ] CHK026 — Are boundary conditions specified at each threshold (expiry instant, retry bound exhaustion, keyspace pressure, idle-retention expiry)? [Now] [Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK027 — Are concurrency conditions specified for every shared-state operation, not only for code generation? [Now] [Coverage, Spec §FR-URL-013]
- [ ] CHK028 — Are requirements defined for the case where a dependency is unavailable mid-operation, distinctly from never-available? [Now] [Edge Case, Spec §EC-011]

## Dependencies, Assumptions & Exclusions

- [ ] CHK029 — Is every assumption recorded with the risk it carries if false, rather than stated bare? [Now] [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK030 — Is every superseded assumption marked superseded rather than deleted, so provenance survives? [Now] [Traceability, Spec §AS-004]
- [ ] CHK031 — Are exclusions stated as bounded scope decisions rather than silent omissions, each with a reason? [Now] [Completeness, Spec §Exclusions]
- [ ] CHK032 — Is every unresolved item recorded with an identifier, impact, current assumption, owner, and decision point? [Now] [Completeness, Constitution I]
- [ ] CHK033 — Is any remaining open finding explicitly *not* treated as decided anywhere in the artifact set? [Now] [Ambiguity, Spec §Deferred Findings]

## Traceability Chain Integrity

- [ ] CHK034 — Is the full chain requirement → scenario → design → ADR → task → code → test → validation → documentation → evidence defined with a representation for each link? [Now] [Traceability, Spec §FR-ORC-027]
- [ ] CHK035 — Does every functional requirement appear in the traceability matrix, with zero requirements absent? [Now] [Traceability, Orphan Requirement]
- [ ] CHK036 — Does every matrix row reference a requirement that actually exists, with zero dangling references? [Now] [Traceability]
- [ ] CHK037 — Is the Design and ADR linkage recorded for requirements whose design decisions have been made? [Now] [Traceability]
- [ ] CHK038 — Is there a defined mechanism by which an orphan requirement, orphan task, orphan implementation, or orphan test is **detected** rather than merely prohibited? [Now] [Gap, Spec §POL-TRC-001]
- [ ] CHK039 — Does every task trace to at least one requirement, with zero orphan tasks? [Post-Tasks] [Traceability, Orphan Task]
- [ ] CHK040 — Does every implemented behavior trace to a requirement, with zero orphan implementation? [Pre-Release] [Traceability, Orphan Implementation]
- [ ] CHK041 — Does every test trace back to a requirement, with zero orphan tests? [Pre-Release] [Traceability, Orphan Test]
- [ ] CHK042 — Does the generated traceability report show zero orphans in **both** directions, and is it produced mechanically rather than by hand? [Pre-Release] [Traceability, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK043 — Does a traceability gap block release readiness rather than merely being reported? [Pre-Release] [Failure Path, Spec §POL-TRC-001]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
- Items tagged `[Post-Tasks]` or `[Pre-Release]` are **not evaluable** at the time of generation: no `tasks.md`,
  no implementation, no test results, and no evidence bundle exist yet. Leaving them unchecked is correct, not
  an outstanding failure.
